item.name: Linken's Sphere

effects.title: Spellblock
effects.text: Blocks most targeted spells once every 14 seconds.

effects.title: Transfer Spellblock
effects.text: Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for 14 seconds.

notes: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Spellblock.
item.lore: This magical sphere once protected one of the most famous heroes in history.
